item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure over Guangxi and the trough of low pressure over the coast of southern China will bring showers and thunderstorms to the regions over the weekend. The two low pressure systems will subsequently become more active. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the following few days, moving towards the seas south of Japan.
